description: This Java class implements a ContentRepository for Amazon S3, providing methods to save, delete, and fetch files and images. It integrates with AWS SDK and uses Spring annotations for component management.

classes.name: S3ContentRepository
classes.description: Implements ContentRepository for Amazon S3, providing methods for file and image management.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves a file to S3 storage, validating size and generating the storage path.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file from S3 storage based on its path.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves an image to S3 storage from an InputStream, associated with a resource ID.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves a Base64 encoded image to S3 storage, constructing the file path accordingly.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image from S3 storage given its location.

methods.name: fetchFile
methods.description: Retrieves a file from S3 as FileData, reading from bytes via SDK.

methods.name: fetchImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image from S3 as FileData.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type, which is S3.

methods.name: putObject
methods.description: Uploads an object to S3 bucket, handling exceptions.

methods.name: deleteObject
methods.description: Deletes an object from S3 bucket, handling AWS exceptions.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Downloads an object from S3 bucket and returns as ResponseBytes, handling exceptions.
